notes.title: Update is now available.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44572924/2998cbb2db8b5631586ed09e14d7181423031062.png[/img]
Thank you for enjoying TENSEI!
We have released an update today.

[h1]Rrelease notes[/h1]

[h2]- Additional languages supported[/h2]
　Korean has been added to the system language.

[h2]- Bug Fixes[/h2]
　Fixed a bug that caused damage determination to be invalid under certain conditions.

We look forward to your continued support of TENSEI.

Project Pegasus

notes.title: Update is now available.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44572924/14b21dd98935d4414dbb8b81d628584405d3d16d.png[/img]

Thank you for enjoying TENSEI!
We have released an update today.

[h1]Rrelease notes[/h1]

[h2]- Additional Achievements[/h2]
　New achievements, including hidden achievements, have been added.

[h2]- Improved environmental visuals and added direction[/h2]
　Various placements were added in the field and reactions were implemented when interacted with.
　In addition, minor improvements have been made to the existing placement and presentation.
　Visitors can enjoy an even more immersive experience while leisurely flying around in the tranquil space.

[h2]- Adjusted stage configuration from certain heights and above.[/h2]
　Modifications were made to landscape changes after 30,000 m altitude.

[h2]- Defects addressed[/h2]
　Several display and behavior issues were fixed.


We look forward to your continued support of TENSEI.

Project Pegasus
